head: PhotoUnlocked adds Portrait and Photographic Styles editing to older photos
dek: PhotoUnlocked prepares photos you shared, downloaded or took with extra editing data, so you can use Portrait, Photographic Styles and Texture adjustments on them in Apple Photos. It was #16 among paid Utilities apps on the US App Store on 5 November.
details: It saves a new copy and leaves the original unchanged. It costs $0.99 with in-app purchases, by Kevin Shah.
means: If you want newer Photos editing tools on older pictures, this is a cheap way to try.
todo: Find PhotoUnlocked in the App Store.
thumb_words: NEW PHOTO EDITS FOR OLD PICS
